field_principles.auroc_delta: RecMem-triggered error-detection AUROC minus eager AUROC where valid.
field_principles.continuous_self_learning_task: True because this is an FR-11 replay-scale task.
field_principles.correctness_delta: RecMem-triggered correctness rate minus eager correctness rate.
field_principles.duration_s: Real wall-clock duration; no sleep padding.
field_principles.energy_delta_mean: Mean initial energy minus RecMem-triggered final energy.
field_principles.field_principles: Per-field accounting rules for the artifact.
field_principles.forgetting_regression_count: Rows whose RecMem final energy or correctness regressed.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal complete:/blocked_ verdict; no inferred live model success.
field_principles.live_llm_called: False because all rows are local verifier-label replay metadata.
field_principles.memory_drift_score: Contradiction rate plus normalized forgetting, clipped to [0, 1].
field_principles.model_weights_mutated: False because no model object or weight tensor is loaded or updated.
field_principles.n_examples: Deterministic local labeled examples selected under the bounded budget.
field_principles.random_seed: Controls deterministic corpus selection for both replay modes.
field_principles.recmem_replay_scaleup_ready: True only when source artifacts are ready, the 50-example target is met, the RecMem trigger fires, token cost falls, and no forgetting/drift guard fails.
field_principles.source_artifacts: Prior Exp 2869/2881 artifacts plus the local clean-corpus manifest.
field_principles.target_examples_met: Whether at least the configured 50-example target was selected.
field_principles.token_reduction_pct: RecMem triggered consolidation token proxy reduction versus eager writes.
